question: How do I book a workspace online?

blocks.text: On the public website, select a physical workspace from the map, then choose a permitted date, start time, and duration. Confirm the capacity, price, and session end time, then enter your first/last name and a reachable booking email to review and submit the request.

After submission, you will receive a queue number and access to a private payment page with specific instructions. You must complete payment and upload genuine proof of payment within the 60-minute server-recorded deadline.

Note that submitting a request or uploading proof does not hold inventory or guarantee a booking. Final allocation is only established when you receive an explicit final confirmation showing the actual physical unit and schedule.

spans.quote: On the public customer website, select a physical named workspace from the map; select a permitted date, start time and duration; confirm capacity, price/pass and session end time (including the next date for overnight use); optionally rank eligible same-type alternatives; enter requested first/last name and a reachable booking email; review the summary and submit. No customer account is required. Keep the queue/reference displayed after submission.

A successful submission creates a pending request and queue number; it does not hold a unit. The website issues booking-specific payment instructions and a private payment page after submission; an initial administrator approval is not required before paying. Complete payment and proof upload before the server-recorded 60-minute payment-session deadline. Administrator review occurs after proof submission and does not guarantee allocation. After payment-proof verification, final allocation must

still find a valid non-overlapping unit from approved choices. Only an explicit final confirmation showing the actual physical unit and schedule establishes a confirmed booking. If all choices conflict, staff must follow the authorized recovery/reconciliation path; payment alone must not cause duplicate allocation.

Website reservations have no integrated card-payment gateway. After submitting a website request, follow the payment methods and recipient details shown on its official private payment page. Submit genuine proof for subsequent administrator review; paying does not require an earlier administrator approval. On-site shared kiosk walk-ins instead offer staff-handled cash or the currently displayed authorized static QR transfer, followed by staff verification. Website payment instructions must never be inferred from an old screenshot or kiosk QR.

A submitted website request receives its private payment page and payment-session deadline. The session lasts 60 minutes from its server-recorded creation, not 24 hours from an approval email. Pay and upload proof before the deadline displayed by the official page. A payment-session QR and a confirmed booking QR are separate; the payment QR does not authorize entry. A link is for the particular approved booking and must not be forwarded or publicly posted.

The final verified message identifies the actual booked workspace, time window and check-in directions. A bank receipt, payment QR, queue number, admin approval email or proof-upload success message is never independently a confirmed reservation.
